app.title: MundaSense AI
app.tagline: Know the risk. Understand the cause. Act before harvest.
demo.banner: Demonstration model: trained only on synthetic data. Results are illustrative and are not field-validated.
demo.shona_review: Shona wording is a demonstration catalogue and requires bilingual agronomic review before field use.
risk.explanation.low: The estimated yield is at or above the provisional demonstration threshold of 3.5 t/ha.
risk.explanation.moderate: The estimated yield is between the provisional demonstration thresholds of 2.0 and 3.5 t/ha.
risk.explanation.high: The estimated yield is below the provisional demonstration threshold of 2.0 t/ha.
result.referral_body: This result should be reviewed with an agricultural extension officer because the risk, confidence, or data warnings exceed the demonstration safety threshold.
result.disclaimer: Decision support only. This estimate is not a guarantee and does not replace field inspection or qualified agronomic advice.
driver.increased: The model associated this value with a higher estimate than its demonstration reference.
driver.decreased: The model associated this value with a lower estimate than its demonstration reference.
driver.neutral: This value had little effect relative to its demonstration reference.
warning.unusual: {feature} is outside the model's robust training range ({lower} to {upper}). Confidence has been reduced.
warning.extreme: {feature} is outside the minimum or maximum seen in the synthetic training data. Verify the measurement before relying on this result.
warning.multiple: Several inputs are unusual for this model. Treat the prediction cautiously and request extension review.
advice.verify.title: Verify unusual measurements
advice.verify.body: Re-check the flagged measurements, units, and assessment period before making a farm-management decision.
advice.high_risk.title: Arrange an extension review
advice.high_risk.body: Review the field condition, crop stage, and recent records with a local extension officer before changing management.
advice.low_confidence.title: Use field evidence before acting
advice.low_confidence.body: The model evidence is weak for this case. Inspect the field and seek extension support rather than relying on the estimate alone.
advice.water_stress.title: Inspect moisture stress and drainage
advice.water_stress.body: Inspect the crop and soil for signs of moisture stress or drainage problems, and monitor local weather and field condition more frequently.
advice.soil_test.title: Confirm soil condition
advice.soil_test.body: Consider a locally appropriate soil test and review the result with an extension officer before changing nutrient strategy.
advice.monitor.title: Continue structured field monitoring
advice.monitor.body: Keep rainfall, crop-condition, and input records current so changes can be reviewed early.
